system.description:
You gain a rank of Mastery to Investigation. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a creature with at least one rank of Confused or Dazed. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead gain the Severed condition.
